I give up. I could not find a way to prove this, and I did not edit `/work/fatex_073.lean`.

The statement is the real theorem that a quotient of a polynomial ring by a homogeneous ideal is Cohen-Macaulay exactly when its localization at the irrelevant ideal is. I checked the definitions in the file for a loophole and found none. `R` is Noetherian, so `moduleDepth` computes the true depth. `IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing` is then the usual condition that depth equals Krull dimension. A proof would have to build the graded-ring argument that passes Cohen-Macaulayness from the irrelevant prime to every other prime. Mathlib does not have that argument, and writing it from scratch here is far beyond what I can do.
